in_game_description: A towel is one of the most useful objects a space traveller can have. You can wrap yourself in it for warmth; use it as a blanket; use it as a sail, a weapon, a mask, a flag, or even just to dry your body.
mechanics_text: One of the largest profit margins of any standard commodity: 4$ min to 210$ max (>5000%).
Description and inclusion are a reference to The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy by Douglas Adams.
